# Visual and Theming Consistency Checklist: Standalone pages use the same content card

**Purpose**: Validate that the card styling requirements are complete, unambiguous and consistent across light and dark themes.
**Created**: 2026-10-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the card's border, background, radius and shadow specified for both themes in one place, with no property left to inference? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-002]
- [x] CHK002 Are the pages covered by the card enumerated exactly (home, About, Work with me, Technology, Contact, Privacy policy, Terms of use, app privacy pages, not-found), and is the excluded set (posts, stories, listings) named? [Completeness, Spec Assumptions, Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK003 Is the card's relationship to the page title, home introduction card and feature image above it (spacing, edge alignment) defined, not only "unchanged"? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK004 Is the position of the draft notice inside the card, and its spacing from the card padding, specified? [Completeness, Spec Edge Cases]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Are "light dusk tint at 80% opacity" and "dark dusk tint at 80% opacity" tied to named theme tokens rather than described in words? [Ambiguity, Spec Assumptions]
- [x] CHK006 Is "subtle shadow" and "the theme's smallest shadow" defined as a named token or measurable value? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK007 Is "the same 1rem radius used in dark mode" consistent with the plan's `rounded-2xl` utility, and is one of them the authority? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Plan Summary]
- [x] CHK008 Is "no new colours outside the site's existing theme" testable, i.e. is it clear which palette entries count as existing? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK009 Do the spec's white-on-white light card and the claim that it is "set apart" by a 1 px border and smallest shadow agree on how much separation is required? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK010 Are the not-found page's card requirements stated as identical to the layout card without any page-specific exceptions (heading, spacing, margins)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK011 Do the home page's inner sections (Now grid, Start here) have requirements for how their own boxes look against the new white card, beyond "looks the same"? [Gap, Spec Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK012 Are requirements defined for wide and full-width images that extend past the card edge, including how they interact with the border and radius? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK013 Is the behaviour for tables, code blocks and other overflowing content inside a narrower text column specified? [Gap, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK014 Is the dark-mode shadow requirement explicit about being allowed to be invisible, and is the dark border the sole required edge? [Clarity, Spec Assumptions]
- [x] CHK015 Are requirements defined for the flash of the wrong theme before the theme is applied (card colours on first paint)? [Gap, Edge Case]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [x] CHK016 Is the assumption that the design source (Flux) departs for the light card recorded as an accepted deviation? [Assumption, Plan Project Structure]
- [x] CHK017 Is the out-of-scope status of a shared "content card" design token consistent with the plan introducing a shared component? [Consistency, Spec Out of Scope, Plan Summary]
